review: 728.1-1: the trigger does not fire at all in opponent_only, so it is the does_not_fire variant; all_lands (trigger fires, no life lost) relabelled other.

scenarios.title: Rad counters mill cards and cost life for nonland cards

setup.notes: A has 3 rad counters and B has 3 rad counters. A's draw for the turn has already been taken. Library lists are top first.

decisions: Both players pass priority in the draw step and the turn moves to A's precombat main phase.
At the beginning of the phase A's rad counter trigger goes on the stack; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The trigger fires for A. A mills Grizzly Bears, Mountain and Shock, loses 2 life for the two nonland cards (18) and removes 2 rad counters (1 left). The three milled cards are in A's graveyard. B's counters are unchanged at 3.

variants.label: all_lands
variants.delta: The top three cards of A's library are Mountains instead of Grizzly Bears, Mountain and Shock.
variants.expected: The trigger fires and A mills three Mountains. A loses no life (20) and keeps all 3 rad counters.

variants.label: all_nonland
variants.delta: The top three cards of A's library are Grizzly Bears, Shock and Hill Giant.
variants.expected: A mills all three nonland cards, loses 3 life (17) and has no rad counters left.

variants.label: opponent_only
variants.delta: A has no rad counters (B still has 3).
variants.expected: The trigger does not fire for A during A's precombat main phase and B's counters do nothing. A's library is untouched, A's life stays 20 and B still has 3 rad counters.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge puts rad counters on a player only through card scripts; setup assumes they are already there. The rad trigger is an internal trigger (InternalRadiation) rather than a printed one.
